stories.label: Iran fires cruise missiles at USS Abraham Lincoln carrier group
stories.summary: Iran claims Qader anti-ship cruise missiles forced USS Lincoln to reposition. No US confirmation. Comes as 82nd Airborne deploys 1,000+ troops.

stories.label: Iran formally rejects 15-point US ceasefire, issues 5 counter-demands
stories.summary: Tehran rejects US ceasefire plan via Press TV. 5 conditions: halt aggression, guarantees against resumption, reparations, end all fronts, Hormuz sovereignty.

stories.label: US sends 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran; Tehran's military rejects talks
stories.summary: US sends 15-point ceasefire via Pakistan including nuclear dismantlement and Hormuz reopening. 82nd Airborne deploying 1,000+ troops simultaneously.

stories.label: Spain PM calls Iran war absolute disaster, refuses US base access
stories.summary: Sanchez tells parliament Iran war is far worse than Iraq 2003. Refuses US base access despite Trump trade threats.

stories.label: Israeli settlers expanding into West Bank Areas B and A, erasing Oslo lines
stories.summary: +972 joint investigation: settlers expanding beyond Area C into PA-jurisdiction zones. De facto annexation without declaration.

stories.label: Meta loses child safety trial: $375M verdict, Operation MetaPhile evidence
stories.summary: NM jury awards 375M. Zuckerberg testified harms inevitable. Two more trials pending. LA jury also finds Meta+Google liable for $3M in separate addiction case.

stories.label: Judge signals Anthropic may win injunction against Pentagon supply chain risk label
stories.summary: Judge Lin: Pentagon designation looks like attempt to cripple Anthropic. 69% Americans want more AI regulation.

stories.label: Bellingcat: Chad strike munitions match Chinese-made bombs used by RSF
stories.summary: Chinese-made GB25A/GB50A bomb remnants at Tiné, Chad strike site. Amnesty linked GB50A to RSF via UAE re-export.

stories.label: ECB Lagarde signals rate hikes possible for Iran war inflation overshoot
stories.summary: Lagarde: ECB could tighten even for 'not-too-persistent' inflation from Iran war energy shock.

stories.label: Iran internet at 1% for 600+ hours — 26 days of near-total blackout
stories.summary: NetBlocks: Iran 1% connectivity for 600+ hours. 88 million people digitally isolated.

stories.label: UK bans crypto donations to political parties, caps overseas gifts
stories.summary: UK imposes immediate moratorium on all crypto donations plus 100k/yr overseas cap. Targets Reform UK.

stories.label: Trump appoints Zuckerberg, Huang, Brin, Ellison to AI tech council
stories.summary: Presidential tech council co-chaired by AI/crypto czar Sacks. Members include major Trump donors.

stories.label: CERN transports antimatter for first time
stories.summary: First successful transport of antimatter, opening path to precision fundamental physics tests.

stories.label: US expands visa bonds to 50 countries — financial barrier to Global South travel
stories.summary: 50 countries now require bonds up to $15k for US tourist/business visas. Mostly African/Global South nations.

stories.label: Supreme Court sides with Cox ISP in music copyright fight
stories.summary: SCOTUS limits music industry ability to extract massive damages from ISPs for user piracy.

stories.label: Trump-Xi summit rescheduled to May 14-15, trade and Iran war on agenda
stories.summary: Summit delayed from March to May 14-15 because of Iran war. Trade tariffs (Section 301 replacing IEEPA after SCOTUS), Hormuz closure, and China's 1.38M barrels/day Iranian crude loss on agenda.

stories.label: Zelenskyy: US conditions security guarantees on Ukraine giving up Donbas
stories.summary: Zelenskyy tells Reuters the US will only finalize security guarantees once Ukraine withdraws from Donbas. Russia betting US will lose interest. Iran war consuming US diplomatic bandwidth.

stories.label: Accidentally released Smith memo reveals Trump kept docs tied to business interests
stories.summary: Jack Smith memo (accidentally released by DOJ) shows Trump kept documents 'only 6 people had access to,' pertinent to business interests. Aide uploaded scans to cloud. Wiles witnessed plane incident.

stories.label: South Africa police commissioner Masemola faces criminal charges in R360M tender
stories.summary: National Commissioner Masemola served court notice for April 21. Connected to R360M Medicare 24 tender via 'Cat' Matlala. 12 officers arrested. Third SA police boss to face charges. Factional war inside SAPS between rival narratives.

stories.label: Bellingcat: 9 Facebook groups with 70k members trafficking protected wildlife in Indonesia
stories.summary: Bellingcat/Mongabay traced 9 Facebook groups back to single Jakarta broker. Endangered species (silvery gibbons, rhinoceros hornbills) traded openly for years despite Meta's ban. Coded language evades detection.

stories.label: Egyptian court acquits documented bus harasser; EIPR calls for appeal
stories.summary: Moqattam court acquitted man despite prosecution confirming repeated harassment of Mariam Shawky. EIPR: verdict tells women 'confronting assault will not get them anywhere.' Only state prosecutor can appeal.

stories.label: Pakistan petroleum dealers postpone strike amid war fuel crisis
stories.summary: PPDA called off planned March 26 strike (demanding 8% margin from 2.59%) because war escalation could cause supply crisis. Kerosene +128%, jet fuel +150%.

stories.label: First brain connectivity atlas maps development from infancy to 100 years
stories.summary: Nature: 3,556 people scanned (16 days to 100 years). Three functional connectivity axes tracked across full lifespan for first time. Sensory-to-association axis peaks at age 19.

stories.label: NASA cancels Gateway, appoints 'Lunar Viceroy' for surface base
stories.summary: Garcia-Galan named program executive for Moon base. $10B per phase. Two landings/year target. Prioritizing supply chain chokehold identification over fancy hardware.

stories.label: WMO: Earth's energy imbalance highest in 65 years, 11 hottest years in a row
stories.summary: State of Global Climate 2025: first time energy imbalance included. Highest in 65 years. 90%+ excess heat absorbed by oceans (record 2025). Guterres: 'Every indicator flashing red.'

stories.label: BRINC launches Starlink-connected police drone: 60mph, 130dB, 640x zoom
stories.summary: First commercially available drone with built-in Starlink. 900+ US cities already using BRINC. Guardian model: 60mph vehicle pursuit, 130dB siren, hour flight time.

stories.label: StreamEast: World's largest piracy network traced to two men in Egypt
stories.summary: 1.6B visits/year, 136M/month. Operated from Sheikh Zayed, Giza. LeBron James spotted watching StreamEast courtside. ACE coalition (50 companies) + Egyptian authorities took it down.

stories.label: Meta shutting down Horizon Worlds, communities abandoned
stories.summary: Meta announced Horizon Worlds shutdown, partially walked back to 'foreseeable future.' AA meetings, churches, art communities face abandonment. Former Meta VR dev: 'psychological torture from corporate neglect.'

stories.label: Iran demands Vance as interlocutor, rejects Kushner and Witkoff
stories.summary: Iran informed Trump administration it prefers JD Vance as negotiating counterpart.

stories.label: Drones from Russia hit Estonian power plant, enter Latvian airspace
stories.summary: Russian drones entered Estonian and Latvian airspace, one hitting Auvere power plant. Third Baltic incident in a week.

stories.label: Israel drops all charges against Sde Teiman soldiers who abused Palestinian detainee
stories.summary: Israel dropped all charges against soldiers filmed abusing Palestinian detainee at Sde Teiman.

stories.label: Meta drops E2EE from Instagram DMs, WANA users at highest risk
stories.summary: Meta removes E2EE from Instagram DMs effective May 8. SMEX warns acute risk for West Asia/North Africa users.
